name: web-release
description: Release a web frontend (Vercel, Cloudflare Pages / Workers static assets, S3/CDN, Netlify) so that production serves exactly the build that was tested, and rolling back is one named command. Covers clean-tree builds, immutable preview deployments, E2E on the preview URL, promote by alias or route switch, build-id proof, cache purge, source maps, and rollback by re-aliasing the previous deployment. Use for any frontend ship step ("выкати фронт", "промоутни в прод", "откати сайт", "почему на проде
author: avelikiy
